label: Open
definition: Anyone can get the data, without registering or asking.

label: Commercial
definition: The data is available to anyone, for a fee or under commercial terms.

label: Internal to the public sector
definition: The data is available only to public sector organisations, or to named organisations, under an agreement.

label: OFFICIAL
definition: Most public sector information. The routine business of government.

label: OFFICIAL-SENSITIVE
definition: OFFICIAL information that needs extra care because it is of interest to threat actors, and is not intended for public release.

label: SECRET
definition: Very sensitive information. Records about it must not be held in an OFFICIAL catalogue.

label: TOP SECRET
definition: The most sensitive information. Records about it must not be held in an OFFICIAL catalogue.

label: No personal data
definition: The data contains no information about identifiable living people.

label: Personal data
definition: The data identifies people, directly or indirectly.

label: Pseudonymised
definition: People are not named, but could be re-identified with other information. Still personal data under UK GDPR.

label: Anonymised
definition: People cannot reasonably be identified, by anyone, with any means likely to be used.

label: Not yet known
definition: Not yet assessed. Use only while the assessment is done.

label: None
definition: None of the kinds below.

label: Special category personal data
definition: Data about health, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation and the other categories in UK GDPR Article 9.

label: Criminal offence data
definition: Data about criminal convictions and offences (UK GDPR Article 10).

label: Data about children
definition: Data mainly about people under 18.

label: Commercially sensitive
definition: Release could harm the commercial interests of the public body or a third party.

label: Security sensitive
definition: Release could help someone attack people, places or systems.

label: Not yet known
definition: Not yet assessed.

label: Everyone
definition: The record can be published openly, even if the data is not open.

label: UK public sector
definition: Any UK public sector organisation can see the record.

label: UK government departments and their bodies
definition: Central government departments and arm's-length bodies can see the record.

label: The publisher only
definition: Only the publishing organisation can see the record.

label: Open Government Licence v3.0
definition: The default licence for open UK public sector information.

label: Non-Commercial Government Licence v2.0
definition: For information that may be reused for non-commercial purposes only.

label: Open Parliament Licence v3.0
definition: For Parliamentary information.

label: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0
definition: An international open licence, compatible with OGL v3.0.

label: Creative Commons Zero 1.0
definition: A public domain dedication.

label: Data sharing agreement required
definition: There is no licence. A data sharing agreement, memorandum of understanding or other legal instrument is needed. Describe it in the rights statement.

label: Never
definition: Published once and not expected to change.

label: Other
definition: A schedule not in this list, such as every ten years. Say what it is in the description.

label: Business and economy
definition: Small businesses, industry, imports, exports and trade.

label: Crime and justice
definition: Courts, police, prisons, offenders and borders.

label: Defence
definition: Armed forces, health and safety, search and rescue.

label: Digital services performance
definition: How government digital services perform.

label: Education
definition: Students, training, qualifications and the national curriculum.

label: Environment
definition: Weather, flooding, rivers, air quality, geology and agriculture.

label: Government
definition: Staff numbers and pay, local councillors and department business plans.

label: Government reference data
definition: Trusted data that is referenced and shared across government departments.

label: Government spending
definition: Payments by government departments over 25,000 pounds and other spending.

label: Health
definition: Smoking, drugs, alcohol, medicine performance and hospitals.

label: Mapping
definition: Addresses, boundaries, land ownership, aerial photographs, seabed and land terrain.

label: Society
definition: Employment, benefits, household finances, poverty and population.

label: Towns and cities
definition: Housing, urban planning, leisure, waste and energy consumption.

label: Transport
definition: Airports, roads, freight, electric vehicles, parking, buses and footpaths.

label: REST
definition: Resources accessed over HTTP with standard methods.

label: SOAP
definition: XML messages over a SOAP envelope.

label: Event or message
definition: Messages or events pushed to subscribers, such as webhooks or a message queue.

label: GraphQL
definition: A query language over a single endpoint.

label: SPARQL
definition: Queries over linked data.

label: OGC web service
definition: Geospatial services such as OGC API - Features, WMS or WFS.

label: File transfer
definition: Bulk files moved on a schedule, such as SFTP.

label: Data owner
definition: Accountable for the data asset, its use and its quality. Named as a post, not a person.

label: Data steward
definition: Looks after the data day to day: its metadata, quality and access.

label: Data custodian
definition: Runs the systems that hold the data.

label: Information asset owner
definition: The senior role accountable for the information asset under information assurance.

label: Distributor
definition: Makes the data available on behalf of the publisher.

label: United Kingdom
definition: The whole UK. Use a nation when you know it.

label: Guernsey
definition: The Bailiwick of Guernsey, including Alderney and Sark.

label: British Antarctic Territory
definition: Has no ISO 3166-1 code of its own; this code is this profile’s.

label: Pitcairn, Henderson, Ducie and Oeno Islands
St Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha
South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands
Sovereign Base Areas of Akrotiri and Dhekelia
definition: Has no ISO 3166-1 code of its own; this code is this profile’s.

label: Canada
definition: Commercial organisations subject to PIPEDA.

label: Japan
definition: Private sector organisations.

label: United States
definition: Organisations certified to the UK Extension to the EU-US Data Privacy Framework (the UK-US data bridge).

label: Not a restricted transfer
definition: The ICO three-step test shows the flow is not a restricted transfer, for example because the receiver is not a separate legal entity, or the data is not personal data in the receiver's hands.

label: UK adequacy regulations (data bridge)
definition: The receiver is in a country, territory or international organisation covered in full by UK adequacy regulations, known as data bridges. Since the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 came into force on 5 February 2026, the test is that protection there is not materially lower than in the UK.

label: Partial UK adequacy regulations
definition: Covered by adequacy regulations for a sector or a class of receiver only, such as organisations certified to the UK-US data bridge.

label: International data transfer agreement (IDTA)
definition: The ICO international data transfer agreement.

label: UK Addendum to the EU standard contractual clauses
definition: The EU standard contractual clauses with the ICO UK Addendum.

label: Binding corporate rules
definition: Binding corporate rules approved by the ICO, for transfers within a group.

label: Instrument between public authorities
definition: A legally binding and enforceable instrument between public authorities or bodies.

label: Administrative arrangement between public bodies
definition: Provisions in an administrative arrangement between public authorities or bodies, authorised by the ICO.

label: Approved code of conduct or certification
definition: An approved code of conduct or certification scheme, with binding commitments from the receiver.

label: An exception (derogation)
definition: One of the exceptions in Article 49 UK GDPR, such as explicit consent or important reasons of public interest. For occasional transfers only.

label: Law enforcement transfer rules
definition: A transfer by a competent authority under Part 3 of the Data Protection Act 2018, which has its own rules.

label: SHA-256
definition: Acceptable today and through the quantum transition for integrity checks. Prefer longer outputs for files that must be trusted for decades.

label: SHA-384
definition: Recommended for long-lived records.

label: SHA-512
definition: Recommended for long-lived records.

label: SHA3-256
definition: A different design from SHA-2; acceptable, and useful for crypto-agility.

label: SHA3-384
definition: Recommended for long-lived records.

label: SHA3-512
definition: Recommended for long-lived records.

label: BLAKE2b-256
definition: Acceptable.

label: BLAKE2b-512
definition: Acceptable.

label: BLAKE3
definition: Acceptable.

label: SHA-224
definition: Too short for new records. Use SHA-256 or longer.

label: SHA-1
definition: Broken against deliberate collisions. Kept so old records still conform; the validator warns (rule Q-01).

label: MD5
definition: Broken. Kept so old records still conform; the validator warns (rule Q-01).

label: Hybrid post-quantum
definition: Negotiates a post-quantum key exchange (ML-KEM, FIPS 203) combined with a classical one, such as X25519MLKEM768 in TLS 1.3.

label: Post-quantum only
definition: Negotiates a post-quantum key exchange alone.

label: TLS 1.3 with classical key exchange
definition: Secure against today's attackers, but data recorded now could be decrypted later by a quantum computer (harvest now, decrypt later). Plan the migration.

label: TLS 1.2 with classical key exchange
definition: Upgrade to TLS 1.3 first; post-quantum key exchange needs it.

label: Not yet assessed
definition: Not yet checked. Checking is part of the discovery work the NCSC asks for by 2028.

label: Training permitted
definition: The data may be used to train and fine-tune AI models under its licence, with no further conditions.

label: Training permitted with conditions
definition: The data may be used for AI training under conditions in the usage policy or rights statement, such as attribution, non-commercial use or a data sharing agreement.

label: Evaluation only
definition: The data may be used to test or evaluate AI models, but not to train them.

label: Not permitted
definition: The data must not be used to train, fine-tune or evaluate AI models.

label: Not yet assessed
definition: The owner has not decided. Treat as not permitted until they do.

label: Accredited official statistics
definition: Official statistics the Office for Statistics Regulation has assessed as complying with the Code of Practice.

label: Official statistics
definition: Statistics produced by a body named as producing official statistics.

label: Official statistics in development
definition: New or changed official statistics still being developed and tested with users.

label: Management information
definition: Data used to run a service, not published as official statistics.

label: Other statistics
definition: Statistics from a body that does not produce official statistics, such as a charity or company.

label: Open
definition: Published for anyone to use, under an open licence.

label: Public
definition: Available to anyone, but under a licence with conditions that make it not open.

label: Shared
definition: Shared with named people or organisations, or groups of them, under conditions.

label: Closed
definition: Not shared outside the organisation, for reasons recorded in the triage, such as security or privacy.

label: Unknown
definition: The correct value is not known to the publisher and cannot be worked out, but it probably exists.

label: Withheld
definition: A value exists but is not given in this record, for example because the record is shared more widely than the value may be.

label: Not applicable
definition: The property does not apply to this resource, so there is no value to give.

label: Not collected
definition: The publisher does not hold this kind of value for any of its resources.

label: Not yet available
definition: The value will be given later, for example once the data is published.

label: Global navigation satellite systems (GNSS)
definition: Positions from satellite navigation signals, such as GPS and Galileo.

label: Satellite laser ranging (SLR)
definition: Distances to satellites measured by laser.

label: Very long baseline interferometry (VLBI)
definition: Radio telescopes observing distant sources, which ties the frame to space.

label: DORIS
definition: Doppler orbitography and radiopositioning integrated by satellite.

label: Interferometric synthetic aperture radar (InSAR)
definition: Ground movement measured from repeated radar images.

label: Levelling
definition: Height differences measured on the ground.

label: Gravimetry
definition: Measurements of gravity, used for heights and the geoid.

label: Vector
definition: Points, lines and polygons.

label: Grid
definition: A regular grid of cells, such as raster imagery or a gridded model.

label: Text table
definition: Tables or text with location in them, such as addresses or coordinates in columns.

label: Triangulated irregular network
definition: A surface made of triangles, often for elevation.

label: Stereo model
definition: A three-dimensional view from an overlapping pair of images.

label: Video
definition: A scene from a video recording.
